dialogues.text: Welcome to Riverside Town, traveler! We're a peaceful community, though monsters have been more active lately in the forest.

options.text: Do you have any work for me?

dialogues.text: Slimes and Goblins have been spotted near the forest edge. Wolves roam deeper in. Be careful out there!
Not at the moment, but check with the blacksmith. He might need materials.
Ah, a warrior! Looking to learn the craft of smithing, or perhaps you need equipment?

options.text: What can you tell me about smithing?

dialogues.text: Blacksmithing is the art of forging weapons and armor. With the right materials and knowledge, you can craft powerful equipment. I can teach you, but you'll need a Blacksmith Certificate first.

options.text: How do I get a certificate?

dialogues.text: Certificates are rare items. Sometimes monsters drop them, or you can find them in treasure chests. Bring me one and I'll teach you the trade.
Do you have a Blacksmith Certificate? I can't teach you without proof of your commitment.
I sell basic weapons and armor. Check my wares!
Welcome to my shop! I have potions, materials, and other useful items for adventurers.
The arcane arts await those with the wisdom to master them. Do you seek magical knowledge?
Magic harnesses the elements and bends reality itself. Fire, ice, lightning - all can be commanded by a skilled mage. But such power requires proper training and a Mage Certificate.

options.text: How do I get a certificate?

dialogues.text: Mage Certificates are found in the wild, usually guarded by magical creatures. Seek them in dungeons or defeat powerful monsters.
To learn the ways of magic, you must present a Mage Certificate. Do you have one?
Welcome to the Riverside Inn! Rest here to restore your HP and MP. Only 50 gold per night!
Riverside Town has been here for generations. We're known for our skilled blacksmith and our proximity to the Whispering Forest. Adventurers often stop here before heading into danger.
Halt! State your business. Oh, an adventurer? Good, we need more brave souls around here.
The Whispering Forest to the north is teeming with monsters - Slimes near the entrance, Goblins and Wolves deeper in. There's also rumors of caves to the east with Skeletons and Golems. Be prepared!
